text: BASS-II (PSI-25), Burning and Suppression of Solids - II, is a flight investigation using the MSG flow duct hardware on the International Space Station (ISS). BASS-II (PSI-25) ran 129 tests according to its PSI experimental table (129 rows). The fuels and sample materials tested in BASS-II (PSI-25) were: Japan wax, Nomex, PMMA, SIBAL (solid fuels). Sample geometries in BASS-II (PSI-25) were: candle, fabric, rod, slab, sphere, thin film. The oxygen (O2) levels in BASS-II (PSI-25) tests ranged from 14 to 22 percent (mole fraction 0.14 to 0.22). The BASS-II (PSI-25) table does not record the ambient pressure. The BASS-II (PSI-25) table does not record the air flow speed. Variables that changed between BASS-II (PSI-25) tests: o2, fuel, geometry. PSI lists these related investigations for BASS-II (PSI-25): PSI-26.

FLEX (PSI-69), Flame Extinguishment Experiment, is a flight investigation using the MDCA in CIR hardware on the International Space Station (ISS). FLEX (PSI-69) ran 274 tests according to its PSI experimental table (274 rows). The fuels and sample materials tested in FLEX (PSI-69) were: Heptane, Methanol (droplet fuels). Sample geometries in FLEX (PSI-69) were: droplet. The oxygen (O2) levels in FLEX (PSI-69) tests ranged from 12 to 34 percent (mole fraction 0.12 to 0.34). The ambient pressure in FLEX (PSI-69) tests ranged from 70 to 309 kPa (0.69 to 3.05 atm). The FLEX (PSI-69) table does not record the air flow speed. Diluent or suppressant gases used in FLEX (PSI-69): N2, N2+CO2, N2+He. Variables that changed between FLEX (PSI-69) tests: o2, pressure, fuel, diluent, droplet_diameter; held fixed: geometry. Recorded test outcomes in FLEX (PSI-69): extinction in 186 tests, disruption in 61 tests, completion in 27 tests. In FLEX (PSI-69), the flame was extinguished in 186 tests run at oxygen (O2) concentrations of 12 to 30 percent. The lowest oxygen (O2) concentration at which a FLEX (PSI-69) test still burned to completion was 14 percent (27 tests burned to completion). The initial droplet diameter in FLEX (PSI-69) ranged from 1.1 to 4.67 mm over 262 tests. The burn time in FLEX (PSI-69) ranged from 0.3 to 39.2 s over 268 tests. The flame extinction diameter in FLEX (PSI-69) ranged from 0 to 4.6 mm over 197 tests.
